newsitem.title: USA: Duramax buys BFGoodrich marine bearing unit.
newsitem.headline: Duramax buys BFGoodrich marine bearing unit.

text.p: BFGoodrich Co and Duramax Inc said on Monday that Duramax has acquired the marine bearings product line from BFGoodrich, a maker of specialty chemicals.
The purchase price was not disclosed.
The product line will be moved to Duramax's manufacturing plant in Middlefield, Ohio from a BFGoodrich facility in Wilmington, N.C.
Duramax Inc is a privately-owned manufacturer of molded and extruded rubber and vinyl products for marine, automotive, industrial and building products markets.
A BF Goodrich spokeswoman said the Wilmington plant, which employs 60 people, is closing at the end of the year.
It could not immediately be determined if there is a charge related to the closing, the spokeswoman said.
